ex3_captions.caption: a moose in the way
ex3_captions.scene: A young woman in a red hat shovels a path through deep snow while a huge moose stands right behind her on the path. A husky walks beside her, and two people watch, shocked, from a window.

ex3_captions.caption: a secret way
ex3_captions.scene: A young woman with a shovel and a husky stand inside a long, narrow tunnel dug through deep snow. Daylight shines in at the open end of the tunnel.

ex3_captions.caption: to lose your way
ex3_captions.scene: A young woman holding a shovel stands in a wide, empty snowy field in fog and falling snow, shading her eyes and looking around. A husky sniffs the snow, and footprints curve behind them.
models: to look for the way back

ex5_story: Anna dug a way out through the snow.
Her husky squeezed past and took it first.
Inside, Dad cheered: “Nice path for the dog!”
ex5_storyModels: Her husky squeezed past and took it first.
But her dog used it before she could.
